name: Fixture Malabar Mess
reviews: The beef ularthiyathu with malabar parotta is the reason I keep coming back.
Portions are generous and the beef fry is properly dry-roasted, not swimming in oil.
Service slow on weekends but the kappa and beef combination is worth the wait.

name: Fixture Syrian Kitchen
reviews: Syrian Christian food done right - the beef olathiyathu and appam is a classic.
Decent duck roast, beef was a bit chewy the day I went.
Nice quiet place for lunch.

name: Fixture Grill House
reviews: Tenderloin steak cooked exactly to medium rare. Pricey but excellent.
Best steak in the city, though you pay for it.
The ribeye is enormous.

name: Fixture Thattukada Corner
reviews: Late night beef roast and porotta, exactly like a Kerala thattukada.
Cheap, fast, tasty. Beef curry is spicy.
Seating is basic but the food is honest.

name: Fixture Anglo Home Kitchen
reviews: Beef cutlets and ball curry just like my grandmother made.
Small takeaway operation, call ahead. The pepper beef is lovely.
Limited menu, changes daily.

name: Fixture Biryani Darbar
reviews: Mutton biryani is the pick here. Beef biryani also available on Fridays.
Crowded at lunch, turnover is fast.
Rice could be better seasoned.

name: Fixture Sagar Veg Bhavan
reviews: Best ghee roast dosa in the area.
Filter coffee is excellent, idlis are soft.
Pure veg, no onion garlic options available.

name: Fixture Udupi Tiffin Room
reviews: Standard Udupi fare, reliable sambar.
Quick breakfast spot.
Vada is crisp.

name: Fixture Sushi Bar
reviews: Fresh fish flown in, the omakase is a treat.
Expensive but genuinely good sushi.
The wagyu gyoza is excellent.

name: Fixture Chettinad Mess
reviews: Chicken chettinad and nattu kozhi soup are the things to get.
Mutton chukka is dry and peppery, very good.
No beef here, but everything else is solid.

name: Fixture Pizza Point
reviews: Thin crust is decent, delivery is quick.
Pepperoni is actually chicken pepperoni, be warned.
Fine for a quick bite.

name: Fixture Barbecue Yard
reviews: Unlimited starters, good value. Mostly chicken and prawn on the grill.
No beef on the buffet.
Dessert counter is weak.

name: Fixture Kappa House
reviews: Kappa and beef varattiyathu, exactly what I wanted.
Toddy shop style, strong flavours. Beef is the star.
Crowded and loud, but the food delivers.

name: Fixture Idli Factory
reviews: Fourteen kinds of idli. The podi idli is the best one.
Cheap and quick.
Open early.

name: Fixture Arabian Grill
reviews: Al faham chicken and kuboos, good late night option.
Mandi is generous. Mutton and chicken only.
Shawarma is reliable.

name: Fixture Cafe Roastery
reviews: Good single origin pourovers.
The beef brisket sandwich at lunch is surprisingly good.
Nice place to work from.

name: Fixture Military Hotel
reviews: Proper military hotel. Mutton kola urundai and nattu kozhi.
Rustic, no frills, excellent gravy.
Goes off the menu by 9pm.

name: Fixture Noodle Wok
reviews: Indo-Chinese, gobi manchurian is the usual order.
Beef chilli is on the menu and it is good.
Portions are big.

name: Fixture Sweet Stall
reviews: Mysore pak and jangiri.
Good for gifting boxes.
Snacks counter is busy in the evening.

name: Fixture Continental Club
reviews: The roast beef with horseradish is a proper old-school plate.
Expensive, formal, excellent service.
Wine list is the best in the city.
